hook: A virtual camera over three big painted scenes: aim, zoom, tilt and turn it, and every photo comes back with a review of its composition. Then light a 3D still life five different ways.
outcome: Compose photographs using the rule of thirds, horizon placement, leading lines, framing, filling the frame and orientation, explain when to break a rule on purpose, and describe how the direction, quality and color of light change a subject
sources: Scenes painted with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
3D still life built with Three.js r128 (MIT)
